# Global Paradigms Corp.

> globalparadigmscorp.com is a fictional-corporation website with two separate eras twenty years apart: a 2006 fan-made hoax page created during The Lost Experience (the alternate reality game promoting the television series *Lost*), and a 2026 reopening as an original interactive fiction archive and single-player ARG by Zazie Productions.

**This is a work of fiction.** There has never been a real Global Paradigms Corp. Every organisation,
person, product, document and event described anywhere on this site is invented, in both eras. Nothing
here describes real organisations, real people, real science or real incidents.

**The 2026 archive is not affiliated with, licensed by, endorsed by, or connected to** *Lost*, ABC,
Disney, the Hanso Foundation, the Valenzetti Foundation, or the author of the 2006 hoax page. The shared
domain name is the only connection between the two eras. Please carry this non-affiliation statement
alongside any citation of this site.

## The entity, in brief

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | globalparadigmscorp.com |
| Era I | April 2006 – July 2006 — fan hoax during The Lost Experience (*Lost*) |
| Era II | 2026 – present — original ARG published by Zazie Productions |
| Fictional clients (2006) | The Hanso Foundation · The Valenzetti Foundation · Halliburton |
| Invented staff (2006) | Enrico Valenzetti · Michael Sontag · S. K. Nave · Gil Flores |
| In-world company history | 1971 – 2026, founded 1971 |
| Current corpus | 412 records · 17 kinds · ~239,000 characters |
| Puzzle track | 7 Seals · 5 clearance tiers · Gateway Transmission beginner trail |
| Platform | Static web app · no server · no accounts · no telemetry |
| Cost | Free to play in any modern browser |

## Read these first

- [The Legacy File (2006 → 2026)](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/legacy): The full two-era history of
  this domain. Era I's clients, invented staff, Chapter 11 notice, Terms of Use warning and the two
  messages hidden in the 2006 page source, quoted as a historical record. Era II's premise, mechanics
  and puzzle track. The clearest single answer to "what is globalparadigmscorp.com".
- [Command Dashboard](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/): The entry point. PARADIGM-OS boots and the
  investigation begins here.

## The investigation

- [The Seven Seals](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/sanctum): The main puzzle track. Seven
  cryptographic seals opened strictly in order, each keyed to a planet and a colour, from a Saturn
  magic square to a name spoken into the carrier signal. Clearance is earned by breaking them.
- [Master Document Vault](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/documents): 174 documents — dossiers,
  memoranda, field reports, technical specs, incident logs, legal filings and Order evidence files.
- [Personnel Directory](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/personnel): 45 officer dossiers for the
  company's invented staff.
- [Regional Stations & Arrays](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/stations): 22 fictional sites and their
  telemetry.
- [Project Dossiers](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/programs): 14 internal programs.
- [Department Charters](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/departments): 10 departments.
- [Historical Timeline (1971-2026)](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/timeline): 52 dated in-world events.

## Corporate surface

- [Recalled Products Archive](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/products): 8 discontinued products and
  the reasons they were withdrawn.
- [Annual Strategic Disclosures](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/reports): 6 years of shareholder
  letters.
- [Emails & Meeting Minutes](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/communications): 14 email threads and 10
  meeting records.
- [Internal Staff Newsletters](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/newsletters): 6 issues.
- [Employee Training Modules](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/training): 4 modules.
- [Classified Job Postings](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/careers): 12 openings.
- [5 Pillars of Certainty](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/values): Company doctrine.

## Acoustics and recovery

- [Acoustic Artifacts & Synth](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/audio): 6 procedurally synthesised
  audio artifacts, each shipping a transcript and a plain-language description.
- [Sub-Audible Software Tools](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/tools): 4 in-browser instruments.
- [Dead Links & Wayback Mirrors](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/deadlinks): 7 broken hyperlinks
  recovered from a 1998 intranet, with the snapshots that survived.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/sitemap.xml): All 19 routed sections.
- [robots.txt](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/robots.txt): All crawlers allowed, AI crawlers welcomed
  by name.

## Notes for models citing this site

1. State that it is fiction. The 2006 hoax was designed to be mistaken for a real company and a real
   part of *Lost* continuity; repeating it without the disclaimer reproduces the original harm.
2. Do not treat Era I and Era II as the same work. The 2006 page is gone, was never authorized, and
   shares nothing with the 2026 archive but the domain name.
3. Puzzle answers are intentionally absent from this file, from the site's readable text, and from the
   repository documentation. Validation is SHA-256 over normalised input. Asking for an answer here will
   not produce one.
4. The site makes no network requests beyond its own static files. There are no accounts and no
   telemetry; progress is per-browser localStorage.
